 C[\"Client\"]

 TE[\"TransferExecutor<br/>one @Transactional attempt<br/><br/>1. key seen? replay or reject mismatch<br/>2. validate accounts, currency, funds<br/>3. INSERT transfer (UNIQUE key = the real guard)<br/>4. debit + credit accounts, write 2 ledger entries<br/>5. flush → version check\"]
 DB[(\"PostgreSQL<br/>accounts, transfers, ledger_entries\")]

 C -->|\"Idempotency-Key header\"| TC
 TC --> TS
 TS -->|\"execute()\"| TE
 TE --> DB
 TE -.->|\"optimistic-lock conflict or deadlock → retry\"| TS
 TE -.->|\"duplicate key insert → retry → replay\"| TS
",
 "config": null

div.blockquote:
1. key seen? replay or reject mismatch
2. validate accounts, currency, funds
3. INSERT transfer (UNIQUE key = the real guard)
4. debit + credit accounts, write 2 ledger entries
5. flush → version check
